title: rest.topics.notes.generation.response
description: GET /api/subjects/{subject_id}/topics/{topic_id}/notes/generation response (since 1.6): the topic's latest notes generation since the backend started.

status.description: idle: none since the backend started; needs_confirmation: a cost cap is reached and nothing was spent (confirm with POST .../notes/generate and confirm_over_cap).

started_at_ms.description: Backend clock, Unix epoch ms; absent when idle.

finished_at_ms.description: Backend clock, Unix epoch ms; absent while idle or running.

version.description: done: the N of apuntes-vN written; absent for a draft.

draft.description: done: true when the notes did not pass the provenance validator.

warning.description: done: a Spanish warning for the student.

detail.description: failed / needs_confirmation: a Spanish sentence for the student.
